artifact.name: Z-Girl Director-Supervised Site-Wide Visual Resilience Pass

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio AI Production Director v1 / shared-product-improvement-v1
review.notes: Director-supervised continuation from the merged PR #54 production baseline. Routes shared Athlete, Faith, Share, and general human-support context photography through the existing governed same-origin support-image delivery layer and updates deterministic visual-conformance QA to recognize that resilient architecture. No new source of truth, media stack, clinical capability, credential activation, provider marketplace, or public-release authority is introduced.

ai_uses.purpose: Director-led recovery, release-blocker identification, shared visual-delivery remediation, deterministic QA adaptation, and release-candidate preparation
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: The Production Director consolidates recurring visual defects into a systemic repair so users receive human-centered imagery reliably instead of discovering broken third-party images page by page.
ai_uses.human_oversight: Owner retains public-release authority; professional/clinical boundaries, credential issuance, provider economics, canon changes, and approved-master replacement remain human-governed.
ai_uses.provenance: lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach PR #55 on factory/sitewide-visual-resilience; supervised under the existing Greene Media Studio shared-product-improvement-v1 Director profile.

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: The current remediation is deterministic and shared-component based; owner and regulated/professional decisions remain gated.

evidence: Shared human-centered visual surfaces use a resilient governed delivery path rather than direct browser dependence on third-party image hosts.
Athlete, Faith, Share, and general human-support variants retain explicit semantic role mappings.
The existing Production Director is reused to convert repeated screenshot-level defects into one systemic remediation pass.
Deterministic QA remains preferred over unnecessary premium generation.
Reliable human-centered visuals reinforce that Z-Girl prepares people for real human support rather than replacing relationships.
No participant health, safeguarding, or private reflection data is added to this work.
Verify Release passed after the shared delivery change.
Visual-conformance QA was updated to validate either governed approved assets or the governed same-origin delivery architecture.
HumanContextStrip retains descriptive alt text and responsive image sizing.
The remediation does not remove text-first access to the same support content.
Existing Z-Girl human-first support doctrine and product repository remain authoritative.
No duplicate Director, canon registry, source of truth, or visual system was created.
The existing Greene Media Studio Director and product-improvement profile are reused with owner gates preserved.
Public release, clinical functions, paid credential activation, referrals, and provider economics remain outside this release candidate.

exceptions: PR #55 requires rendered preview verification before merge.
Public release and any professional/clinical/credential/provider activation remain separately governed.
